title: Test-only transport overlay for the proof records draft (not a FAIR-bioHeaders contract)
description: Companion to bundled-proof.json for FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools-Java#2: the PRM row is an embedded-records draft, so its registry entry must name a transport overlay, its digest, the extension key and the carrier type. This file exists only to let that be tested. It is not a contract, not pinned by any development repository, and never referenced by the shipped schemas/bundled.json.
